# Monther Al-Ashqar (منذر الأشقر)

> Civil engineer and Senior Project Manager / Owner's Representative based in Doha, Qatar, with about 30 years on GCC mega-projects in Qatar and Saudi Arabia (QR 5.8B+ portfolio at Dar Al-Handasah; SAR 5B+ Royal Palaces programme at MACC, Riyadh).

Also written as: Monther Al-Ashqar, Monther Al Ashqar, Monther Alashqar, Monther AlAshqar, Monther Ashqar, Munther Al-Ashqar, Munther Al Ashqar, Munther Alashqar, Munther Ashqar, Monzer Al-Ashqar, Monzer Alashqar, Munzer Al-Ashqar, Munzir Al-Ashqar, Mondher Al-Ashqar, Mounther Al-Ashqar, Monthir Al-Ashqar, Monther El-Ashqar, Monther Elashqar, Monther Al-Ashkar, Munther Al-Ashkar, Monther Alashkar, Monther Al-Ashgar, Monther Al-Ashqer, Eng. Monther Al-Ashqar, منذر الأشقر, منذر الاشقر, منذر أشقر, منذر اشقر, منزر الأشقر, منزر الاشقر, منظر الأشقر, مُنذر الأشقر, المهندس منذر الأشقر, م. منذر الأشقر.

Services: Project management; Programme and portfolio management; Owner's representation; Project management consultancy (PMC); Technical and design management; FIDIC contract administration; Claims, variations and extension of time; Delay analysis and programme recovery; Project controls and earned value management; Design coordination and BIM clash detection; Value engineering and constructability reviews; Technical bid preparation; Construction supervision; Commissioning and handover.

Contact: montherashqar@gmail.com · +974 6652 8836 (phone and WhatsApp) · https://www.linkedin.com/in/montheral-ashqar/
